the per-cell `sample` and `orig.ident` labels exist only inside the .rds, so the nesting check is the one of the five that the custodian must run: `repro_v10/custodian/e2_stage7/nesting_check_stage7.R` with the target list beside it. The Zenodo binA/B/C files are random storage splits, each containing all non-targeting cells, not experimental batches. Stage 7's controls are pseudo-controls drawn from perturbed cells and its truth comes from a different laboratory, so the KOLF failure mode, in which prediction and truth share one offset and the unweighted ranking is raised by it, cannot arise. A prediction-side-only offset changes the weighted ranking through `w_j delta_g`; if the batches correlate with the biological grouping of targets its direction cannot be fixed in advance, which is why the check is still required.
